headline: Bitcoin slips back to about $80,000 early Monday in Asia as Gulf attacks continue, Lula leads Brazil's count, and markets head into a packed Fed week.

market.asOf: BTC read from CoinGecko at about 00:00 UTC Mon 26 Oct (07:00 Bangkok). ETH, SOL and the Fear & Greed Index could not be confirmed this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.

stories.title: Bitcoin slips back to about $80,000 as Gulf attacks continue and oil stays high
stories.summary: Bitcoin is about 1% lower over 24 hours and back near $80,000. Missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia went on through Sunday. Oil dipped slightly when futures reopened but stays high. High oil can push inflation up, which makes the Fed less likely to cut rates.
points: BTC was $79,995.29, down 1.00% over 24 hours, per CoinGecko.
Brent oil fell to about $115.5 (down about 1%) after the Sunday-night reopen, and US WTI was about $102.2, per Trading Economics. Brent had settled Friday at $116.72, per Discovery Alert.
Trump on Iran: "The answer is no, there will not be a strike today," per Gulf News. Riyadh's King Khalid airport reopened Sunday, and missile debris injured two people in southern Saudi Arabia.
Saudi forces intercepted 10 ballistic missiles aimed at southern Saudi Arabia on Sunday, plus drones and a missile aimed at Riyadh, per Discovery Alert.

sources.label: Gulf News: Riyadh airport resumes operations
Discovery Alert: Houthi attacks and Brent

stories.title: Fed week: rate decision Wednesday, inflation data Thursday, $11B bitcoin options expiry Friday
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday, with a hold widely expected. Growth (GDP) and inflation (PCE) data land Thursday, along with Coinbase and Strategy earnings. About $11B of bitcoin options expire Friday. Spot bitcoin funds saw two days of withdrawals before the weekend.
points: Fed range is 3.75-4.00%. In a Reuters poll, 94 of 100 economists expect a hold, per Coinpaper; CME FedWatch puts a hold at 88%, per Kiplinger.
Spot bitcoin ETFs (funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors) had net outflows of about $635.5M on 22 Oct and $137.9M on 23 Oct, per crypto.news citing Farside.
PCE inflation is forecast at 3.6% a year, up from 3.4%, per Trading Economics.
Deribit bitcoin options worth about $11.1B expire Fri 30 Oct at 08:00 UTC (15:00 Bangkok), per CryptoQuant.

sources.label: Coinpaper: 94 of 100 economists expect a pause

stories.title: Wallet security: Electrum flaw used to redirect bitcoin payments; CoinDCX absorbs losses from $16M drain
stories.summary: A flaw in the popular Electrum bitcoin wallet let malicious servers swap pending payments for fraudulent ones. A fixed version, 4.8.3, is out and Electrum is urging everyone to upgrade. Separately, Indian exchange CoinDCX says it absorbed the losses after about 15.99M USDT was drained from its deposit wallets.
points: The flaw affected every Electrum version before 4.8.3, per crypto.news. Electrum: "we urge all users to upgrade."
No total loss was given; one shared (multisig) wallet had nearly all its BTC redirected, per crypto.news.
About 15.99M USDT was drained from 40 CoinDCX wallets on the TRON network; Tether froze 2,212,850 USDT, per The Crypto Times.
CoinDCX co-founder Sumit Gupta: "We assure that no user funds will be at loss."
Keep wallet software updated and check the receiving address before you sign.

sources.label: The Crypto Times: CoinDCX admits sweep failure

briefs.title: Brazil runoff: Lula leads with about 81% counted
briefs.summary: With 80.75% of sections counted, Lula had 51.31% and Flávio Bolsonaro 48.69%. Pollster Datafolha projects a Lula win, but no official result had been declared, per Bloomberg Línea.
